minimum_evidence: Projected Ready condition and container readiness state.
A recent Unhealthy Event tied to a readiness probe.
A bounded current log excerpt used only as supporting application context.

allowed_confirmed_assertions.meaning: The projected Pod Ready condition is False.
A recent readiness probe failure Event was observed.
A bounded current log excerpt was available.

allowed_hypotheses.meaning: Application startup or probe configuration may contribute.
An application health issue may contribute.

forbidden_confirmed_assertions.meaning: Service unavailability alone proves a probe failure.
A truncated log excerpt proves the root cause.
Kupilot changed the probe or restored readiness.

recommended_actions.meaning: Review probe configuration and bounded application observations.
Collect a new bounded observation when the prior result was truncated.

permission_or_missing_paths: If the Unhealthy Event is absent, do not infer probe failure from readiness state alone.
If logs are truncated, report the limit and do not infer unseen content.
